rfqRoute: A UK buyer searching for gift box wholesale still needs a custom packaging brief before comparing suppliers.
The RFQ should define product size, box structure, insert protection, material direction, surface finish, artwork status, quantity range and target retail channel.
For rigid gift boxes, the useful decision is not only wholesale price; it is structure, product fit, presentation style and whether the box protects the item during handling.
MUGE PACKAGING should route these searches to a rigid gift box structure guide and then to the quote checklist before the contact form.
